name: ZigZagEvgeTrofi ver. 1
summary: This EA uses the ZigZag indicator to identify trend reversals and opens trades in the direction of the newly identified trend. It enters positions when the ZigZag confirms a new swing high or low, aiming to capture trending moves from reversal points. The strategy is a systematic trend-following approach based on ZigZag pattern recognition.
summary_zh: 该EA使用ZigZag指标识别趋势反转点，并在新确认的趋势方向上开仓交易。当ZigZag确认新的摆动高点和低点时入场，旨在从反转点捕捉趋势行情。这是一种基于ZigZag形态识别的系统性趋势跟踪策略。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ZigZag指标检测价格波动的极值点（波峰和波谷），以此判断趋势方向的变化。当ZigZag指标确认一个新的低点形成时，EA判断上升趋势开始并做多；当确认一个新的高点形成时，EA判断下降趋势开始并做空。入场条件依赖于ZigZag参数（如深度、偏差、回撤）的调校，这些参数决定了 swing point 的灵敏度。出场条件通常基于固定的止盈止损或反向ZigZag信号触发平仓。仓位管理方面，EA提供手数参数供用户配置，但未见明显的动态仓位调整或基于账户权益的资金管理逻辑。风险控制依赖止损设置，但ZigZag指标的重绘特性可能导致信号回溯，增加虚假信号的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the ZigZag indicator to detect extremum points (peaks and troughs) of price swings, thereby identifying changes in trend direction. When the ZigZag confirms a new trough, the EA determines an uptrend has started and opens a long position; when a new peak is confirmed, it identifies a downtrend and opens a short position. Entry conditions depend heavily on the ZigZag parameters (such as Depth, Deviation, and Backstep), which control the sensitivity of swing point detection. Exit conditions are typically based on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or closing positions on opposing ZigZag signals. Position sizing is configured via a lot size parameter, but there is no apparent dynamic position sizing or equity-based money management logic. Risk control relies on stop-loss settings, though the repainting nature of the ZigZag indicator may cause signals to be revised retrospectively, increasing the risk of false signals.

parameters.name: ZigZag Depth
parameters.description: ZigZag指标深度参数，控制swing point检测的灵敏度
parameters.description_en: ZigZag depth; controls swing point detection sensitivity

parameters.name: ZigZag Deviation
parameters.description: ZigZag偏差参数，定义有效波动的最小幅度
parameters.description_en: ZigZag deviation; minimum valid swing amplitude

parameters.name: ZigZag Backstep
parameters.description: ZigZag回撤参数，限制最近swing point之间的最小K线数
parameters.description_en: ZigZag backstep; minimum bars between swing points

pros: ZigZag指标直观地识别趋势反转点，逻辑清晰易于理解
趋势跟踪策略在强趋势行情中能够捕获较大的利润波段
参数可调允许用户根据不同品种和周期优化swing point灵敏度
pros_en: The ZigZag indicator intuitively identifies trend reversal points with clear and easy-to-understand logic
The trend-following strategy can capture large profit swings during strong trending markets
Adjustable parameters allow users to optimize swing point sensitivity for different instruments and timeframes
cons: ZigZag指标具有重绘特性，历史信号可能被修改，导致回测结果不可靠
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制，固定手数在不同市场条件下风险敞口不一致
在震荡市中频繁产生虚假反转信号，容易造成连续亏损
未包含新K线检查机制，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
cons_en: The ZigZag indicator has a repainting nature where historical signals can be modified, making backtesting results unreliable
Lacks dynamic position sizing and money management mechanisms, resulting in inconsistent risk exposure across varying market conditions
Generates frequent false reversal signals in ranging markets, easily leading to consecutive losses
Does not include a new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same signal
improvements: 增加新K线检查逻辑，避免同一信号重复入场；结合其他指标（如ATR或均线）过滤虚假ZigZag信号
引入基于账户权益的动态仓位管理，并根据ATR设置自适应止损止盈，以适应不同市场波动性
improvements_en: Add a new bar check to prevent duplicate entries on the same signal; combine with additional indicators (e.g., ATR or moving averages) to filter false ZigZag signals
Introduce equity-based dynamic position sizing and ATR-adaptive stop-loss/take-profit to accommodate varying market volatility

risk_points: ZigZag指标重绘特性导致信号可能被事后修改，实盘表现可能与回测不一致
缺乏新K线检查可能导致重复开仓，增加不必要风险敞口
震荡行情中虚假信号频繁，缺少趋势过滤机制
risk_points_en: ZigZag repainting means signals can be revised after the fact, causing live performance to diverge from backtests
Lack of new bar checking may cause duplicate position openings, increasing unnecessary risk exposure
Frequent false signals in ranging markets without a trend filter mechanism
